\caption{\textbf{Progressive \sca{} against every $4096^2$ baseline.} FLUX.1-dev, \nmain{} Aesthetic-4K prompts, seed label 0. Each cell is progressive \sca{} minus the column's method, with its 95\% paired interval below it. Per-image metrics use 2000 prompt draws; FID, KID and their patch versions use 1000 draws that also resample the 168 reference-image clusters. Single-pass: single-pass \sca{}. \up{Blue} / \dn{orange}: the interval excludes zero in favour of / against progressive \sca{}; lower is better for FID and KID, so their signs read the other way. Inception score has no paired interval (Table~\ref{tab:all_metrics}). The point estimate lies outside its percentile interval for Full attn. patch FID, as it can for a biased statistic. Key result: progressive \sca{} is significantly better than AReA, DyPE, SEGA, and full attention on every per-image metric and than UltraImage on nine. Its differences from HRDiT on ImageReward, HPSv2.1, and PickScore span zero, and its patch FID is higher than AReA's, HRDiT's, and single-pass \sca{}'s.}
